style.label: Theme
style.intro: Dusk is the neon night and comes first; Zine is the photocopied day; High contrast is for anyone who asks for more.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A control slapped onto the page: heavy capitals on acid with a hard shadow that presses in when you push it; a quiet ghost in monospace for the rest.

components.name: Door
components.summary: A lit arch that goes somewhere: a real link drawn as a doorway, from Depthfield's doors, in neon.

components.name: Ticker
components.summary: One line of news that runs along a slapped strip, and stops when you point at it or tab into it.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A sheet torn from a zine and taped over the art, or, for the neon side, a pane of glass lit from behind.

components.name: Grain
components.summary: Photocopy grain over art and paper, and a halftone for flat fills, so nothing looks rendered.

components.name: Chrome
components.summary: Liquid-metal type for one display line: the dusk reflected in chrome, with a slow light passing over it.

components.name: Misregister
components.summary: Two print plates that slipped: cyan to one side, magenta to the other, so a word looks run off a cheap press.

components.name: GridFloor
components.summary: A neon grid floor that runs toward you under the dusk band; together with the Sun it makes the Horizon, the system's one scene.

components.name: Sun
components.summary: The banded disc at the horizon: acid light at the top, tangerine, then magenta, cut by bars that thin toward the bottom.

components.name: Scrawl
components.summary: Marker notes in the margin, written by the people who made the page: an aside, a correction, an arrow at the thing that matters.

components.name: Stamp
components.summary: A rubber mark: a word or two in spaced monospace capitals inside a double border, struck at an angle in the accent.

components.name: Sticker
components.summary: A slap tag: a short word or two in heavy capitals on acid, orange, magenta, mint or cyan stock, outlined and shadowed in photocopy black and turned a little.

components.name: Tape
components.summary: A strip of masking tape holding a card or a picture to the page.
